scope: One prespecified paired feature experiment on repeatedly used development data: append accepting-piece fork and reply-check with missing indicators, plus check-only control, to all 75 unchanged original features. Original masked mating_acceptance is unchanged. No app/model changes, engine queries, new labels, full fit, model selection procedure, classifier tuning or sweep.
control: Original150 columns in identical order (75 original values+75 original missing indicators). Both check-only and bundle use same154column names/order: original150 +acceptor_fork,reply_check +two missing indicators. Check-only replaces acceptor_fork with constantfalse whereverknown, preservingnullwhereunknown; bundle uses actualfork. This isolates fork information while matching feature-index randomization and missingness. No gate,row,weight changes; min of bothwindow scores.

learners.custom: Original Tree AST;64 trees,max depth6,>=8 distinct moves per leaf,mtry=isqrt(150/154)=12;whole-group bootstrap;negative split cost5;raw UNWEIGHTED bootstrap-window leaf positive proportions;exact original seed streams. Weights affect split cost only.

standard_rf.sample_weight: Same per-move initial equal total eligible-window weight; unweighted classes

primary: custom_fork_check versus custom_retuned: more true positives without extra false positives on pooled outer OOF. Fork-added-value contrast is custom_fork_check versus predefined check-only custom_check. Report negative outcome equally.
secondary: RF bundle versus original RF and RF bundle versus check-only RF; custom bundle fixed5/6 versus original fixed5/6; no pooled outer-label cutoff or winner selection.

folds.mapping: Sorted unique groups by(sha256(salt+colon+group),group), index modulo fold count

threshold_selection: Each arm chooses cutoff independently using only inner OOF labels. Reference is original custom at5/6. Maximize true positives subject BOTH to FPcount<=reference FPcount and wrong fraction<=reference wrong fraction (cross product). Exact unique observed min-window scores; keep ties together. Tie: fewerFP, then higher cutoff. Empty awards if no feasible nonempty point. No outer labels used. Fixed bundle control uses5/6.
verification: All group/alias/canonical-position integrity assertions; no train/test group overlap. Original150 columns byte-for-value identical including masked mating_acceptance, all75 feature values, all75 missing indicators. Original custom and RF outer scores match saved standard-learners<=1e-12 on all3724cases, original custom_fixed/custom_retuned/RF awards exact; finite scores. Source, feature, extraction and evaluator hashes verified before first fit.
reporting: All3724 outer OOF scores+awards, five fold inner cutoffs and metrics, pooled and fold metrics, gained/lost correct/wrong keys, eligibleECtrue/false strata, original429 eligible positive misses from originalcustom_retuned, feature availability and known-both metrics. Hypothesis-panel24group exclusion applies to outer-test descriptive reporting only, without removing these groups from training. EC/miss/panel breakdowns are descriptive, not independent validation; all429miss labels were already diagnosed.

uncertainty.method: Paired whole-group bootstrap conditional on fixed outer OOF predictions
uncertainty.caveat: Excludes refitting uncertainty and repeated-research selection bias

hypothesis_panel.scope: Exclude groups only from descriptive outer-test reporting; never remove from fitting folds. Same already-examined hypothesis panel, not fresh validation.

pre_fit_refinement: Before freezing or any fit, check-only control matched bundle154column width/names/order and fork missingness, with fork known values constantfalse, to avoid feature-count/random-column-index confounding. No outcomes used.
